name: premiere-mcp-imt
display_name: Premiere-MCP-IMT + SKILLS — Premiere Pro for AI agents
description: Drive a running Adobe Premiere Pro from Claude: sequences, cuts, clips, effects, keyframes, markers, captions, exports and frames — plus the Premiere agent skill for its AI tools.
long_description: Premiere-MCP-IMT by Immersive Media Technologies. About 380 Premiere Pro operations behind nine MCP tools (catalog, do, batch, verify, sequence, save, frame, connector, skill; raw ExtendScript only when you allow it), readback-verified writes, no telemetry; ships the Premiere agent skill: how to drive the program, and when and how to use Premiere's AI tools (Generative Extend, Generative Media, Object Mask, text-based editing, captions, Enhance Speech, Search, the AI Assistant) and their combinations. Built for localized Premiere, not just English: works on every UI language Premiere ships. Requires Adobe Premiere Pro 2024+ running on this computer; the agent installs the Premiere connector on first use, with your consent (pr_install_connector). Apache-2.0 license; unofficial, not affiliated with Adobe Inc.

readOnly.title: Read-only mode
readOnly.description: On: nothing may modify the Premiere project — inspect and export check frames only. Recommended for the first session on a new machine.

enableScript.title: Allow arbitrary ExtendScript (pr_execute_script)
enableScript.description: Off by default. Arbitrary scripts can touch the file system; enable only for a trusted agent.

compactTools.title: Compact tool set (recommended)
compactTools.description: On: nine tools, every operation reached through pr_catalog / pr_do (about 1.5K tokens of tool definitions). Off: all ~380 operations as separate tools (about 150K tokens per turn).
